name: AltTextLab AI Alt Text Generator: Bulk Image Alt Text for SEO & Accessibility
author: AltTextLab

sections.description:
AltTextLab – AI Alt Text Generator for WordPress

AltTextLab automatically writes accurate, SEO-optimized and accessible alt text for every image in your WordPress media library – the moment you upload, or across your entire existing library in one bulk run.

Features

  • Automatic alt text on every upload
    Every new upload gets alt text generated immediately, no manual trigger needed.

  • Bulk alt text generation with no image limit
    Process your entire media library – no matter how many images it contains – with fast, reliable bulk processing.

  • Context-aware alt text
    AltTextLab reads your post title and configured SEO keywords alongside each image, so every description is relevant to the content it appears in.

  • WooCommerce integration
    AltTextLab reads your product name, brand, color, and material alongside each image to write alt text that serves both screen reader users, search engines, and LLMs.

  • Works with your SEO plugin
    Integrates natively with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, All in One SEO, The SEO Framework, SmartCrawl, and Squirrly SEO. Focus keyphrases from your SEO plugin are automatically pulled and naturally woven into the generated alt text.

  • Compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder
    Alt text is written directly to WordPress’s standard media library database – the same field every page builder and theme reads from. There are no sync issues, no custom field mapping.

  • All major image formats supported
    JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, and AVIF, including modern formats that other tools often skip.

  • Multi-language support
    Generate alt text automatically in over 130 languages. WPML Translation Support.

  • Forever free plan available
    AltTextLab has a permanent free plan that gives you 25 credits per month at no cost.

External service for alt text generation

This plugin connects to the API provided by AltTextLab.com to create alt text for images using AI. This service is essential for the plugin’s core functionality.

What data is sent and when:

The plugin may send the following data to AltTextLab when generating alt text:
– The image URL or a base64-encoded version of the image
– Keywords
– The article or product title
– Brand and other relevant attributes, depending on plugin settings

The plugin may also send a request to fetch the current status of the connected AltTextLab account in order to display account information within the WordPress admin interface.

This external service is provided by AltTextLab.com. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “AltTextLab”.
  3. Click Install, then Activate the plugin.
  4. Create your account at alttextlab.com.
  5. Connect your account by entering your API key in the plugin settings.
  6. Upload a new image – alt text is generated automatically. Or open Bulk Generate to process your existing images.
sections.faq:
How does the AI alt text generation work?

The plugin sends your image to the AltTextLab processing server. The AI-powered engine analyzes the image content alongside any configured context (post title, product name, focus keyphrase, custom keywords) and returns a description tailored to your settings. That description is written directly to the standard WordPress alt field immediately, with no manual step.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. AltTextLab has a permanent free plan that gives you 25 credits per month at no cost, with no credit card required. Each credit is equal to alt text for one image. You can stay on the free plan as long as you like. When you need more than 25 images a month, paid plans start at $5/month for 100 credits. Pay-as-you-go credit packs are also available as a one-time purchase if you prefer not to subscribe.

How do I automatically add alt text to all images in my WordPress media library?

Open the AltTextLab plugin in your WordPress dashboard and click Bulk Generate. The tool scans your entire existing media library and processes all images with missing alt text in a single run. You can filter by post type, page, or product before you start. For large media libraries, images are processed in sequence without affecting your site’s front-end performance or page load speed.

Can I control the terminology and keywords in the generated alt text?

Yes. AltTextLab lets you specify relevant keywords to include in every generated description. If you use Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or another supported SEO plugin, your focus keyphrase is pulled in automatically as well.

Can I review or edit alt text before it appears on my site?

Generated alternative text is saved to your media library, where you can review and edit it at any time. The plugin maintains a processing history so you can audit what was generated, when, and for which images.

Does it work with WooCommerce product images?

Yes. AltTextLab has a dedicated WooCommerce e-commerce mode that reads your product name, brand, color, and material for each image and generates alt text specific to the product. It works on main product images and gallery images.

Will the plugin overwrite my manually written alt text?

No, not by default. AltTextLab only fills in images that currently have an empty alt attribute. Any alt text you’ve written manually is left exactly as it is. If you want to regenerate descriptions across images that already have alt text, that’s available as an explicit opt-in setting.

Can I use one AltTextLab account across multiple WordPress sites?

Yes. One account covers any number of WordPress installations with no per-site fees. Credits are shared across all your sites, and each install connects via its own API key linked to the same account.

Does alt text stay if I uninstall the plugin?

Yes. Generated image descriptions are written permanently into the standard WordPress media database. Removing the WordPress plugin has no effect on descriptions already saved – they stay in place indefinitely, exactly as written.

Is AltTextLab GDPR-compliant? What happens to my images?

Yes. Images processed by URL are never stored on our servers and are never used to train AI models. Only the generated alt text is saved to your account for your own reference. The service is fully GDPR-aligned and compliant with EU data handling requirements for you and your site visitors. If you send image files directly, they are stored only for the duration of processing and can be deleted on request.
